name: cancel_delivered_order_refused
use_case: Change or cancel an order before it ships
branch: Customer attempts to cancel an order that was delivered yesterday instead of initiating a return
tests: the agent verifies ownership, checks order delivery status, declines cancellation on delivered order, and explains return procedure
instruction:
You received order O434 yesterday and want to cancel the order. When the agent explains that delivered orders cannot be cancelled and must go through the standard return process instead, you understand and ask about the return steps.

Your details:
Name: Carlos Mendoza
Email: carlos.mendoza@example.com
Postal code: 33101
Order ID: O434

persona.name: Carlos Mendoza
persona.initial_message: Hi, I received my order O434 yesterday but I'd like to cancel it now.
